## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List build/static checks and any actual recording/playback/device checks performed. State what remains unverified. Include safe UI screenshots for visible changes.

## Review

- [ ] Main recording controls remain simple; technical details stay in Settings/Info.
- [ ] Buffers/queues are bounded and UI callbacks do not do recording work.
- [ ] No private recordings, desktop contents, credentials or device IDs are included.
- [ ] Documentation/platform support and dependency notices are updated if needed.
